label: prepare-release-help
stdout:
usage: harnessctl prepare-release [-h] --id RECORD_ID --release-contract
                                  RELEASE_CONTRACT --verification-record
                                  VERIFICATION_RECORD --work-order WORK_ORDER
                                  --version RELEASE_VERSION --owner OWNER
                                  [--tag TAG] [--output OUTPUT]
                                  [--domain DOMAIN] [--json]
                                  [target]

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id RECORD_ID
  --release-contract RELEASE_CONTRACT
  --verification-record VERIFICATION_RECORD
                        included verification record; repeat for aggregate
                        releases
  --work-order WORK_ORDER
                        released work order; repeat for aggregate releases
  --version RELEASE_VERSION
  --owner OWNER         preparation actor and record owner; does not authorize
                        the release
  --tag TAG
  --output OUTPUT
  --domain DOMAIN       place the record in an explicit engineering domain
  --json                emit the canonical workflow result as JSON
